notes.title: Don't Breathe In! – Darkness Begins: Coming Soon to Steam!
notes.content:
A dark presence is leaking from the laboratory, and the gas is spreading...
The tension rises as Don't Breathe In! enters Steam's Coming Soon phase.

Are you ready to confront the unknown?
Hallucinations, broken systems, and whispers in the shadows await you.
But remember: don’t trust everything you see.

Add it to your wishlist now,
because when the power goes out... you’ll wish you never entered.

—

Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3601370/Dont_breathe_in/
